aitareya_chapter5_verse1.title: Aitareya Chapter 5 Verse 1
aitareya_chapter5_verse1.introduction: This verse belongs to Aitareya, Chapter 5.
aitareya_chapter5_verse1.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Aitareya Upanishad, Chapter 5, Verse 1, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
aitareya_chapter5_verse1.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
